name: Håvedalen - Krokstrand
routeType: point-to-point official Bohusleden stage; hilly border-area and Idefjorden stage on old road, forest path, bare or mossy rock, conifer forest and road/path approaches toward Krokstrand

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: Stage 25 Håvedalen - Krokstrand
keyFacts: Primary official name is 25. Håvedalen - Krokstrand.
West Sweden Trails facts are 11 km, 3-4 h and hard/red.
Stage is in Strömstads kommun, Norra Bohuslän, Västra Götaland.
The official stage runs from Håvedalen to Krokstrand and continues the exact official joins from Stage 24 and into Stage 26.

Route starts at Håvedalen, follows woodland and an old customs/toll road near the Norwegian border, climbs steeply over bare or moss-covered rock, passes views around Brämstjärnet, Husebotjärnen and Sandvatten, descends through conifer forest and opens toward Idefjorden.
Kuststigen joins on the descent toward Idefjorden and follows the same corridor toward Krokstrand.
Krokstrand is described in official/municipal context as a stone-industry heritage village, and Strömstad municipality identifies Krokstrand Folkets Hus as Bohuslän's oldest Folkets Hus.
WST public status API returned an empty list on 2026-04-30.

WST places API associated transport stops, Krokstrand/Björnerödspiggen parking, Grillplats Krokstrand, Utsikt Idefjorden, Vindskydd Allemarken, Vindskydd Sandvatten, Vindskydd Björnerödspiggen and Villa chez KoS.
WST campsite/lägerplats and drinking-water/dricksvatten category queries returned zero items for this stage.
caveats: WST place API includes nearby/off-route and adjacent-stage context; each POI needs proximity and import-scope filtering.
No official public drinking-water point was confirmed.
Official status is time-sensitive and must be rechecked before publication.
